E1_purity_clean_eb_power_ge_0.8.population: primary clean-eb items (Kepler-labelled ones included, as in scoring) with power >= 0.8; before DR4 the coarse power stands in for the measured power
E1_purity_clean_eb_power_ge_0.8.basis: power-weighted mean of the sealed p_pred, sum(p_pred x power)/sum(power), the expectation of the estimator; 95% from refitting the Kepler model on bootstrap resamples

E2_off_target_fraction.directional: the off-target fraction rises monotonically across the four crowding bins of neighbour flux within 21 arcsec
E2_off_target_fraction.basis: the survey's identity stage (results/identity_counts.json): eb items closed OFF_TARGET over those closed OFF_TARGET, KNOWN, KNOWN_REVISE or passing identity; a weakly informed prior, so the interval is wide

E3_p_vs_2p_accuracy.basis: agreement of the sealed call with Kepler's own odd/even where Kepler decides

E4_calibration.prediction: Brier skill score > 0, with a 95% interval excluding 0

E5_period.prediction: over recovered items not in the sigma_P calibration half: robust std (1.4826 x MAD about the median) of (P_Gaia - P_TESS)/sigma_P in [0.8, 1.4], median in [-0.5, 0.5], at most 15% at the window edge
E5_period.basis: end-to-end simulation with heavy-tailed period errors (results/validation/e2e.json)

checks.false_rate: false ON_STAR rate on shuffled controls <= 0.01
checks.positive_controls: observed/predicted in [0.8, 1.15]; observed >= power - 0.2 per bin with n >= 30
